propositions: The sidecar channel records gate-run limits (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) but not consumption (requests, tool_calls) due to _ALLOWED_FIELDS sanitization allowlist admitting only the ceiling and discarding the measurement.
Five of six emit_gate_error call sites pass no diagnostic at all, preventing plan-review preflight and completion preflight/mid-run errors from persisting consumption counters to the sidecar store.

The completion verdict sidecar carries no run metadata (requests, tool_calls, duration) while the plan-review sidecar already carries per-call requests and a metrics block, creating asymmetry between the two gates.
Gate-run consumption data is answerable locally from per-checkout usage.jsonl but remains invisible to rebar audit show and other agents because it never reaches the ticket store sidecar channel.
Completion gate consumption metrics must survive to the sidecar on both PASS and FAIL branches to reach parity with plan-review sidecar telemetry.
